Blessed with unmatched strength, she’s thrust into the Royal Knight Order, turning her quiet days into chaos. Now, she must juggle school, the knight life, and her overwhelming power. Who knew gorilla strength could be so complicated?

182104.description:
Based on the erotic game by Msize.

Masaki Fujiwara has a problem. Recently, he's been aware that he's been feeling lust towards his mother. He understands that it's not normal. But he can't suppress his overflowing emotions. Unable to even talk to his close childhood friend about it, he becomes frustrated... and his reason reaches its limits. He keeps staring at his mother's beautiful back. Her voluptuous body arouses his sexual desire. Even her gentle motherly voice draws Masaki's heart... and finally, he touches her. But his mother's reaction is something Masaki never expected. "What a child... lusting after your own mother...!" His mother's angry voice and hands torment Masaki's actions, yet for some reason a strange sense of elation wells up inside Masaki's heart. And the same thing was happening to his mother, Mitsue's heart. A masochistic mother (no blood relation) and a childhood friend with a queenly temperament. Which will your true nature choose?

(Source: Getchu, translated and edited)

182140.description:
A psychopathic killer known as Egg Man has been caught, incarcerated and is awaiting his death sentence. Karen, a beautiful and brave police woman, is assigned to the "Egg Man" case to find the whereabouts of a missing dead body. Egg Man meets his cellmate, Prisoner 205. Who is Prisoner 205? Is Prisoner 205 another in-mate awaiting his death sentence as well or an android utilized by the police to collect information about him and his knowledge of the corpse? Who is really manipulating whom?

(Source: Anime News Network)

182255.description:
Following the First-Class Mage Exam, the trio—elven mage Frieren, warrior Stark, and first-class mage Fern—gains access to the dangerous Northern Plateau. As the party presses onward toward Aureole, formidable adversaries force Stark to confront his insecurities, solidifying his resolve and his role as the party's frontliner. Meanwhile, Fern continues to cherish the gifts she has been blessed with throughout her life, each a reminder of those she holds dear.

Frieren—still honoring her vow to understand humanity—revisits memories of her journey with the Hero's party and her fleeting encounter with a legendary figure. As she reflects on the passage of time, the elven mage quietly questions whether she has truly changed, yet in the small, almost subtle choices that she makes, there are signs that she might have become more human than she realizes.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

During the all-student praxis dungeon training he undertakes with Lihanna and the other top students of his year, they are ambushed by a mysterious mage. Though they barely manage to survive the attack together, they go on to face the exit exam. Can Will reach the girl waiting for him in the tower?

Don't hold back, ok...?" Thus begins a forbidden relationship... Welcome to Guilty Pleasure, where anything is allowed--

182578.description:
Taiyou Asano has settled into his career, having married into the Yozakura spy family. While he still struggles to control the powers granted to him by his wife, Mutsumi Yozakura, Taiyou works hard to complete missions alongside his new siblings. After taking down the organization Tanpopo, Taiyou and the Yozakuras agree to look after six-year-old Ai, one of Tanpopo's test subjects. However, Taiyou's health soon begins to decline due to the Yozakura blood within his body. He dreams that the first head of the family, Tsubomi Yozakura, gives him a new mission: to kill her. To that end, he will have to learn more about his new family, become a silver-ranked spy, and push himself even more to succeed and continue protecting his family.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

182616.description:
After the tragic events in Kamakura, Tokiyuki Houjou has overcome the worst and started restoring his noble family. His next goal is incredibly ambitious—retaking Kamakura, no matter the cost. However, achieving his goal proves difficult as the region goes through turbulent times while its people are exhausted from their uneasy lives.

To make matters worse, some of the current rule's higher-ups are hot on Tokiyuki's trail and hope to expose him. But alongside his skilled and treasured retainers, Tokiyuki will do anything to rebuild his realm as he utilizes his elusiveness in both combat and speech.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)
